name: BundleWP Notification Bar
author: BundleWP

sections.description:
BundleWP Notification Bar adds a fully customizable announcement bar to your WordPress site. Promote sales, share important updates, or drive visitors to any page with a call-to-action button.

Features

  • Custom bar text with basic HTML formatting (rich text editor)
  • Call-to-action button with custom text, URL and new-tab option
  • Color pickers for background, text, button background and button text
  • Position top or bottom; sticky (fixed) or static in page flow
  • Dismissible close button with cookie memory (configurable days, or session-only)
  • Display rules: all pages, homepage only, or specific post types, plus per-ID exclusions
  • Scheduling: automatic show/hide between start and end date/time (site timezone)
  • Show after scrolling a set number of pixels, with slide, fade or no animation
  • Mobile responsive with an option to hide the bar on small screens
  • Live preview in the admin settings page — see changes before saving
  • Clean object-oriented code, no external dependencies, translation-ready

sections.installation:
1. Upload the bundlewp-notification-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Notification Bar > Bar Settings to configure the bar text, colors, position and rules.
  4. Use the live preview on the right to check your design, then click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
How do I change the bar text and button?

Go to Notification Bar > Bar Settings. Edit the “Bar text” with the rich text editor and set the “Button text” and “Button URL” fields.

Can the bar be shown only for a limited time?

Yes. Under Scheduling, set a start and/or end date and time. The bar appears and disappears automatically (times use your site’s timezone under Settings > General).

How does the dismiss button work?

When “Dismissible” is enabled, visitors see a close (X) button. Clicking it hides the bar and stores a cookie for the number of days you configure (“Remember dismissal”). Set 0 to remember only for the browser session.

Can I show the bar after the visitor scrolls?

Yes. Set “Show after scroll (px)” to e.g. 300 and the bar will appear once the visitor scrolls past 300 pixels.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. The bar is rendered in the footer and positioned with JavaScript, so it works with any theme, including those without wp_body_open support.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The text domain is bundlewp-notification-bar and strings are wrapped for translation.
